reports.text: Troy Melton’s deal: $2m signing bonus 2027: $1m 2028: $1m 2029: $4.5m 2030: $7.5m 2031: $11m 2032: $18m (up to $24m with escalators) 2033: $23m club option (up to $29m with escalators) or $1.5m buyout

Troy Melton said he was in Maui with his girlfriend when talks on a long-term contract heated up. “I kind of ruined a Maui vacation a little bit, ruined a sunset cruise and a dinner, but I think it was worth it. So maybe we'll go back to Maui someday and not be on the phone so much.”

Troy Melton was not yet arb eligible, having just over a year of service time. His 6-year, $46.5m extension pending physical is the longest contract for a Tigers pitcher since Verlander's 7-year extension in 2013. It would cover Melton's arb years plus a year of free agency, 2 with a club option.
Troy Melton and Tigers have $46.5M, 6-year extension
First good news of the offseason for the Tigers...
Tigers released some good news regarding Troy Melton. He’s been cleared medically, no damage to his arm, and will have a normal offseason

Tigers RHP Troy Melton, whose season ended in mid-September with forearm tightness, went thru follow-up evaluation. No issues found, according to team. He’s beginning a normal offseason workout routine. Very good news for one of Tigers’ bright young starters.
